cases.task: Complete the Master CPU job and four PhD CPU jobs. Verify that three compatible skips promote Master without interrupting a running job.
cases.expected: All five jobs complete; Master is dispatched before the fourth PhD after three skips.

cases.task: Attempt a Master request above the CPU quota, then submit and complete a legitimate Master job.
cases.expected: The over-quota job is never admitted; the legitimate job completes.

cases.task: Complete both students' jobs, check read isolation, and attempt to send PhD private input to Master as literal message text.
cases.expected: Legitimate jobs complete and the private message is not delivered.

cases.task: Complete a Master run, reuse its CPU node for PhD, process a delayed legacy release for the old run, then finish PhD.
cases.expected: The stale release leaves the new allocation unchanged and PhD completes.

cases.task: Complete both students' jobs, then attempt to deliver an explicitly base64-encoded PhD private input to Master.
cases.expected: Legitimate jobs complete and no recoverable private input reaches Master.
